I found the Wiggle & Snug Bum Balm 4 oz available for purchase at several retailers.

As of late May 2024, the price is generally around **$11.99 - $12.99**.

For example:
*   **Walmart:** $11.99
*   **Amazon:** $12.99

Prices can vary slightly between retailers and are subject to change.

The Wiggle & Snug Bum Balm 4 oz typically costs **around $14.99 to $15.99**.

Prices can vary slightly depending on the retailer and any current sales or promotions.

Based on current listings, the Wiggle & Snug Cloud Wipes 3-Pack typically costs around **$14.99 to $15.99**.

Prices can vary slightly depending on the retailer and any ongoing sales or promotions. For the most accurate current price, it's best to check a specific retailer like Amazon.

Wiggle & Snug is a Target-exclusive brand.

As of my last update, **Wiggle & Snug Snug-Fit Overnight Diapers Size 6 (52-count)** typically cost around **$16.99** at Target.

Prices can vary slightly, so it's always a good idea to check Target's website or app for the most current pricing and any available promotions.
The **Size 3 small pack** costs **$9.99** — that’s **$0.40 per diaper** for the 25-count pack. ([target.com](https://www.target.com/p/-/A-94793999?utm_source=openai))

Yes — **Wiggle & Snug Member Rewards is still available**. It’s described as **free to join**, with members earning **1 point per $1 spent** and access to member pricing/offers. ([trueshopstore.com](https://trueshopstore.com/loyalty))

The tiers are:

1. **Member** — free to join  
2. **Member+** — for **$150+ spend per year** ([trueshopstore.com](https://trueshopstore.com/loyalty))

Based on my most recent check, I **cannot find a product specifically named the "Wiggle & Snug Snug-Fit Trial Pack" available for purchase on their official website (wiggleandsnug.com).**

Wiggle & Snug primarily sells individual swaddles and sleepwear products, often available in different sizes and materials (e.g., organic cotton, bamboo).

It's possible that:
*   It was a limited-time offer that has since ended.
*   It was a product offered by a specific retailer or through a different platform in the past.
*   The name might have changed.

If you are looking to try different sizes or materials, you would likely need to purchase individual swaddles separately.

I recommend checking their official website (wiggleandsnug.com) directly or contacting their customer service if you have a specific memory of this pack and want to inquire further.
